comment: Populated 33x18 vero board above a bare cuts-and-links view; three MC33172P dual op-amps, six 914 diodes, four pots and a three-lug switch (Sw1-Sw3) whose type the drawing does not state. Marked VERIFIED. An italic 'VR' label sits beside the ground wire at top left with no part attached.
uncertain: 10K2 at the left of the board (third column of parts, beside 4K3): printed clearly, unusual value
Switch on Sw1/Sw2/Sw3: type not printed; three lugs so entered as SPDT (the pedal's three-way toggle would be on/off/on)
Several resistors are drawn translucent/standing over other parts (100K beside 4u7, 1M at lower left, 10K lower centre, 4K7 and 100K lower centre-right); counted as separate parts
rows: toggle, lugs Sw1-Sw3; type not given on the drawing
